title: 86. The Teenage Girl's Guide to Increasing Confidence, Self-Esteem, and Self-Love feat. The Teen Life Coach, Sami Halvorsen

minis.title: Fix Your Self-Confidence in Five Minutes!
minis.blurb: you'll learn the importance of building confidence and how you can start boosting your self-confidence today

description_html:
Today I'm joined by Sami Halvorsen, the host of The Teen Life Coach podcast and the founder of Knowing Up. In this episode, Sami and I discuss her personal journey with self-love, the most common challenges teens struggle with, the importance of being proud of ourselves and celebrating little wins, beginning your self-compassion journey, why teens today are struggling more than ever with self-esteem, how low confidence can impact your life, and how self-love and self-confidence are connected!

Sami's Website: https://knowingup.com/

Sami's Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/thelifecoachforteengirls/

summary: sadie and sami halvorsen, founder of knowing up and host of the teen life coach podcast, talk about building confidence and self-love as a teenager. they cover common struggles like anxiety about going to school, fear of saying the wrong thing, and comparing yourself to others. sami shares how self-confidence isn't about being perfect—it's about allowing yourself to feel awkward, vulnerable, and judged without running away. the conversation offers practical ways to celebrate small wins, lead your brain instead of letting it run the show, and start loving yourself even when things are hard.
